Navo v1.0.0

- First public Navo release for Windows x64 and Android 8.0+, including Android TV and Google TV. Connect your supported music server or Bandcamp collection, browse, download, and listen.
- Preview and save generated radio recipes, refresh batches, replay their exact order, and keep stations playing with their original seeds and tuning.
- Browse Home, Playlists, Library, Radio, and My with adaptive navigation, an expanded player, mini-player controls, and a queue drawer or pinned queue.
- Resume playlists, pin Quick Access items, filter favorites, follow cached and online lyrics, and choose shared theme and player-background preferences.
- Use Android Auto, Google Cast, and Navo Connect remote control (beta) where supported.

Upgrade notes

- This is a separate app from upstream Naviamp and earlier cn.com.letalk.naviamp builds. Import shared settings deliberately and reconnect accounts; there is no automatic data or credential migration.
- For local Navo 2.12.x builds, download 1.0.0 manually. On Windows, back up settings and uninstall the development installer first. Android build 66 can update build 65 with the same signing key.
- Aurral requires 3.x; capabilities and permissions vary by provider. Use Navo 1.0.0 on devices sharing generated-station settings (sync schema 2).

Known issues

- Windows packages are not publisher-signed. No Navo store listing or Apple/Linux download is included.
- Connect remains beta; Cast requires compatible online media and a reachable receiver. Vehicle integration depends on the head unit and is not established by emulator checks.
